loudness-equalization-dsp-filter.title: Loudness Equalization DSP Filter
loudness-equalization-dsp-filter.description: Implement an offline dynamic range compressor / loudness equalization DSP pipeline in Python with numpy/scipy based on reverse-engineered loudness equalization techniques.

algorithmic-integer-factorization-discre.title: Algorithmic Integer Factorization & Discrete Log Experiment
algorithmic-integer-factorization-discre.description: A lightweight Python experiment implementing classical discrete logarithm and integer factorization heuristics (e.g. Pollard rho, Baby-step Giant-step) inspired by recent algebraic computation research.
